cultural_control_en: Choose resistant cultivars when replanting, as susceptibility varies widely between varieties.
Prune out infected twigs and cankers in dry weather and burn or discard them away from the orchard.
Avoid excess nitrogen and overhead irrigation; both encourage lush, disease-prone growth.
Space and prune trees for good airflow so foliage dries quickly after rain.

Select proven resistant varieties for any new orchard block.

Sanitize pruning tools between trees.
Plan a winter dormancy spray programme with your local agricultural extension office.
